title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-nina
content:
2026-03-04 - Daily scratchpad (quick)
Owner: Nina Patel
Team: Partnerships / Marketplace

Top priorities for today:
- Follow up with CloudNova on API auth and key rotation (see convo notes below)
- Send tech spec + sandbox invite to CloudNova and BetaMarket by EOD
- Create initial integration checklist in Confluence (stubbed) and assign ENG-1245
- Quick smoke test of sandbox with sample payloads once infra ready

Meeting notes: sync with CloudNova (30m)
- Attendees: Nina, Samir, CloudNova (Aisha), Jordan (PM)
- Timeline: target beta integration by 2026-04-01; production by 2026-05-01 if no major blockers
- Tech: they will authenticate via mTLS or API key; prefer mTLS but can start with API key for POC
- Data: they will send minimal payloads (text prompts + metadata) and expect streaming responses; need tokenization guidance for cost estimates
- Blockers: their security team needs SOC2 evidence + KMS integration notes; engineering wants a sample request/response and rate limits
- Actions:
  - Nina: send tech spec, sandbox invite, and sample payloads (Due: 2026-03-04)
  - Samir: prepare SOC2 + security summary doc, ping security for KMS integration checklist (Due: 2026-03-06)
  - Jordan: create JIRA epic and link to ENG-1245 for infra work (Due: 2026-03-05)

Integration checklist (working draft)
- [ ] Add partner to internal tracker (marketplace partners spreadsheet)
- [ ] Create sandbox org + API key (or mTLS cert)
- [ ] Provide sample request/response examples (JSON) and streaming example
- [ ] Define rate limits & burst behavior for POC (suggest 20 rps, 200 concurrent tokens)
- [ ] Provide expected SLA for beta (latency SLOs)
- [ ] Verify data retention and logging expectations (PII? none)
- [ ] KMS/HSM: outline key flow and rotation cadence
- [ ] Security docs: SOC2 summary, pen-test reports if requested
- [ ] Billing / pricing model for marketplace listing (rev share? flat fee?)
- [ ] Legal: standard MSA + DPA review (send to legal)
- [ ] Launch checklist: demo script, marketing blurb, partner listing assets

Quick technical notes / reminders:
- Need to add streaming example that uses function/tool-calling for structured outputs (i.e., to parse partner's product IDs)
- Check sequence length edge cases for their sample payloads (they may send long product descriptions)
- Recommend quantized model variant for cost vs. quality during POC; note in tech spec

Unresolved questions:
- Will CloudNova require dedicated capacity or is shared hosted API sufficient for their latency targets? (ask them to confirm expected qps patterns)
- Who owns rate limiting policy if they exceed POC thresholds? (we propose automatic fallback to lower-cost model)

Communication TODOs:
- Draft email to CloudNova with: tech spec, sandbox invite, sample payloads, next meeting time options
- Ping infra (Jordan + infra-team) to provision sandbox VPC + test GPU nodes (ref: ENG-1245)
- Add Confluence stub: /pages/CONF-2481-partner-integration-spec and move checklist there

Quick links / refs:
- Confluence spec (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/CONF-2481-partner-integration-spec
- JIRA epic: JIRA-ENG-1245
- Slack: #partner-integrations (pinned: onboarding-checklist)

Personal notes:
- Keep email concise; include clear asks and attachments (tech spec + example payloads)
- If infra ETA slips, propose a demo using hosted API with rate limits to keep momentum
- Remember to loop legal early if they ask for contract changes

End of notes.
